prompt: Create ONE polished full-body adult woman collectible fashion illustration, vertical 1:2, both complete shoes inside frame with ground margin, thin ivory rounded border. No text, logos, real team badges, watermark or copied trademark patterns. Refined CLEAN semi-realistic anime illustration, precise thin lines, smooth controlled shading, clear texture differences. Reference1 is rendering ONLY: never copy its outfit, pose, head angle, face or background. Reference2 is brand material/structure research ONLY: do not copy whole outfit, model, colours or print. Recompose intentionally with bold wearable editorial proportions. Head absolutely upright, neck vertical, ears level; no sideways head tilt, no coy hair-touch pose. Theme: Utility. Coherent group atmosphere: design workshop and urban work courtyard, crisp functional fashion, no military costume. This card alone has a distinct dominant palette: 酒红／白／焦糖; target colours #7A374B,#E9E2D3,#A2754A. Do not dilute all colours into beige or grey. Outfit: Burgundy brushed wool long overshirt with fitted waist tabs, ivory high-neck fine knit and cognac straight calf skirt with original diagonal snap panel and deep front step pleat, burgundy low laced shoes. Tailoring is translated into practical collar/cuff and waist control; pocket map and skirt original. Material targets (designer choices, not certifications): 绒面羊毛／细针织／挺棉. Hair: slick side-part short bob with one sculptural finger wave. Pose: A decisive natural walking stride across a low threshold, shoulders balanced, one arm swings while other holds a small original folded bag low; head upright looking forward, not over shoulder. Scene: design workshop and urban work courtyard, crisp functional fashion, no military costume, location variant 3: a low broad step and open passage, three-quarter view. Make theme clear through clothes and mood, not only props. Keep hands anatomically natural, no excessive background clutter.
